reference_sql:
WITH base AS (
  -- one row per quarter of 2025 and account with MRR at the end of the quarter before
  SELECT CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) AS quarter_start, m.account_id, a.segment
  FROM mrr_monthly m
  JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = m.account_id
  WHERE m.month IN (DATE '2024-12-01', DATE '2025-03-01', DATE '2025-06-01', DATE '2025-09-01')
), churned AS (
  -- one row per account and quarter with a churn event
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('quarter', event_date) AS DATE) AS quarter_start
  FROM subscription_events
  WHERE event_type = 'churn' AND event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT b.quarter_start, b.segment, COUNT(*) AS accounts_at_start, COUNT(c.account_id) AS churned_accounts,
  COUNT(c.account_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS churn_rate
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN churned c ON c.account_id = b.account_id AND c.quarter_start = b.quarter_start
GROUP BY b.quarter_start, b.segment

WITH base AS (
  -- one row per quarter of 2025 and account with MRR at the end of the quarter before, with a churn flag
  SELECT CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) AS quarter_start, a.segment,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscription_events e WHERE e.account_id = m.account_id AND e.event_type = 'churn'
      AND e.event_date >= m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AND e.event_date < m.month + INTERVAL 4 MONTH) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS churned
  FROM mrr_monthly m
  JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = m.account_id
  WHERE m.month IN (DATE '2024-12-01', DATE '2025-03-01', DATE '2025-06-01', DATE '2025-09-01')
)
SELECT quarter_start, segment, COUNT(*) AS accounts_at_start, SUM(churned) AS churned_accounts, AVG(churned) AS churn_rate
FROM base
GROUP BY quarter_start, segment

solver.query:
WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT CAST(m AS DATE) AS quarter_start FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2025-10-01', INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AS t(m)
), base AS (
  SELECT q.quarter_start, r.account_id, a.segment
  FROM quarters q JOIN mrr_monthly r ON r.month = CAST(q.quarter_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)
  JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = r.account_id
)
SELECT b.quarter_start, b.segment, COUNT(*) AS accounts_at_start,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM subscription_events e
    WHERE e.account_id = b.account_id AND e.event_type = 'churn'
      AND e.event_date >= b.quarter_start AND e.event_date < CAST(b.quarter_start + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS DATE))) AS churned_accounts,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM subscription_events e
    WHERE e.account_id = b.account_id AND e.event_type = 'churn'
      AND e.event_date >= b.quarter_start AND e.event_date < CAST(b.quarter_start + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS DATE))) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS churn_rate
FROM base b
GROUP BY b.quarter_start, b.segment
